* Secretary of State [[Colin L. Powell]] says that the United States is willing to sign a treaty with Russia on limiting strategic [[nuclear weapon]]s, indicating a possible shift in administration policy after withdrawing, last December, from the [[Antiballistic Missile Treaty of 1972]]. President [[George W. Bush]] and President [[Vladimir Putin]] are set to hold an arms reduction summit meeting in Moscow in May.&nbsp;– ''Background material: [[nuclear disarmament]], [[nuclear warfare]], [[nuclear proliferation]].''
